sections.text:
In the heart of a dense tropical forest, where there were tall trees and wild animals, lived a huge and powerful lion, the undisputed king of the jungle.

The lion was exhausted after a long day of hunting, so he lay down under a large tree and slept deeply, snoring with a sound like muffled thunder.

Meanwhile, there was a very small, playful mouse running through the forest looking for berries and nuts.

Without intending to, the little mouse climbed the sleeping lion's body, thinking it was a small mound of dry grass, and began running on his back and face.

The little mouse's feet woke the lion from his deep sleep. He opened his eyes very angrily, and with a quick movement like lightning, he raised his huge paw and caught the poor mouse.

The little mouse became trapped between the lion's strong claws, and the lion opened his wide mouth full of sharp teeth, preparing to swallow it in one mouthful!
The mouse trembled with fear, and cried out in a weak, crying voice: “Please, my lord, the great king! Pardon me just this once! I am a small and weak creature and I did not mean to disturb you!”

The mouse added sincerely: “If you pardon me and let me live, I promise that I will never forget this favor of yours, and perhaps a day will come when I can return the favor and help you!”

When the lion heard what the mouse said, he stopped roaring and burst into a loud, mocking laugh that shook the entire forest.

The lion said while laughing: “You? You, microscopic being, are you helping me? I am the king of the jungle and the strongest animal in it? This is the funniest joke I have ever heard in my life!”

Despite his mockery, the lion was in a good mood after he had had enough of hunting, so he decided to pardon the mouse, saying: “I will let you go because you made me laugh. Go away and do not bother me again.”

The mouse thanked the lion hundreds of times, and ran as fast as he could to hide in his small hole underground.

A few weeks passed after this incident, and one day, the lion was wandering around his kingdom to check its conditions.

Suddenly, the lion fell into a tight trap set by professional hunters to catch large animals, and a huge network of thick ropes was wrapped around his entire body.

The powerful lion tried to tear the nets with his claws and teeth, and the more he moved, the more tightly the ropes wrapped around him until he was completely unable to move.

The lion realized that he was inevitably doomed, so he began to roar in a loud and frightening voice that carried all the meanings of pain and despair to ask for help.

All the animals of the forest heard the lion's roar, but no one dared to approach for fear of the hunters and the lion itself.

But the little mouse was in his hole, so he heard the voice and recognized it immediately and said to himself: “This is the voice of the king who saved my life! I must help him!”

The mouse ran quickly towards the source of the sound, and found the huge lion tied up and surrendering to despair, waiting for the hunters to come to kill him.

The mouse said bravely: “Don’t worry, sir, I will rescue you immediately, as I promised you before!”

The lion did not believe that the mouse could do anything, but the little mouse began, with its very sharp teeth, to gnaw and cut the thick ropes of the net.

The mouse gnawed one rope after another patiently and persistently, until it was able to make a large hole in the net.

The lion rushed with his strength and tore the rest of the ropes, and emerged from the trap free thanks to this very small creature!
The lion looked at the mouse with deep respect and appreciation, and said apologetically: “I was wrong when I made fun of you, brave friend.

You saved my life today."

The mouse smiled and said: “No thanks, I have kept my promise to you.”

Small size does not prevent us from doing great things.”

Since that day, the lion and the mouse became the closest friends in the forest, and they learned that kindness begets kindness, and that every creature has its value and importance, no matter how small or weak.
